issues.reason: The unqualified instruction never to move a traumatized person omits the grave and imminent danger exception. The MIT official quiz teaching text explicitly recognizes that exception: https://www.mit.gov.it/nfsmitgov/files/media/normativa/2021-09/Flusso%20Poligrafico.pdf (70545). Qualify or omit the added instruction in all four languages.

The claim that police must be informed for every injury is not established by the cited evidence: the Questura page blocked access and the Ministry 118 guidance concerns emergency medical response. The cited ACI 2004 manual p. 39 specifies serious injuries, not every injury. Provide verified authority for the broader claim or revise while respecting the printed verdict.

The assertion that any injury requires police attendance is not established by the cited evidence: the Questura page blocked access; Ministry 118 guidance does not establish police attendance for every injury. The ACI manual p. 39 addresses serious injuries. Supply supporting authority or revise while preserving the printed verdict.

The explanation does not address the specific duration “until the officers arrive.” The cited ACI discussion describes assistance according to circumstances, not a universal duty for every rescuer to remain until police arrive; Ministry guidance also does not establish that duration.
